title: Counter Group 1 Requested Integrated Totals Report
purpose: Exercise a counter-related I-format ASDU carrying cause 38 in a parseable 104 frame so mutations can vary type, count, and integrated-total payload fields without malformed framing.
expected_behavior: Parses as a 104 I-format ASDU with TypeID 15 (integrated totals) and cause 38, entering the counter-requested monitoring/report path or being rejected only on higher-layer state/policy grounds rather than frame syntax.
constraints_preserved: Uses IEC 60870-5-104 APDU start byte 0x68 from supplied function reference
Length octet 0x12 matches 18 bytes following it
Cause of transmission 38 preserved exactly from supplied operation catalog
Single information object encoded with VSQ=1 and one 3-byte IOA
Common address kept little-endian 0x0001 as conservative standard 104 layout
issue_safety_notes: PK-only seed; no vulnerability claim. Payload is a safe structural analogue for counter-group requested traffic and does not reuse the malformed historical blob.
